```{r}
#| label: setup
library(targets)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(gt)

snapshots <- tar_read(snapshots)
bt <- tar_read(backtest)
params <- snapshots$params
gates <- snapshots$gates
shots <- tryCatch(tar_read(shot_calibration), error = \(e) NULL)
cov <- tar_read(coverage)

c_power <- "#d1622a"; c_resume <- "#3a6ea5"; c_muted <- "#77756f"
theme_report <- theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), plot.title.position = "plot",
        axis.title = element_text(color = c_muted))
```

## Convergence gates

Every snapshot is fit with 4 chains × 1000 draws and should pass R̂ ≤ 1.01, ESS ≥ 400 (bulk and
tail), zero divergences and E-BFMI > 0.2. `check_build.R` fails the build when the live
season's latest snapshot misses a gate.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-gates
#| tbl-cap: "Gate results by season"
gates |>
  left_join(params[, c("season", "snap_date", "secs")], by = c("season", "snap_date")) |>
  group_by(Season = season) |>
  summarise(Snapshots = n(), Passed = sum(pass), `Worst R̂` = max(max_rhat), `Min ESS` = min(min_ess),
            Divergences = sum(divergences), `Fit time (min)` = sum(secs) / 60) |>
  gt() |>
  fmt_number(`Worst R̂`, decimals = 3) |>
  fmt_number(c(`Min ESS`, `Fit time (min)`), decimals = 0)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-failed
failed <- gates |> filter(!pass)
if (nrow(failed) > 0) {
  failed |>
    select(season, snap_date, kind, max_rhat, min_ess, divergences, min_ebfmi, worst) |>
    gt(caption = "Snapshots that missed a gate") |>
    fmt_number(c(max_rhat, min_ebfmi), decimals = 3) |>
    fmt_number(min_ess, decimals = 0)
}
```

## Estimated structure

```{r}
#| label: fig-params
#| fig-cap: "Population-level parameters at each season's final snapshot. Home court and game noise are per 100 possessions."
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 6
params |>
  filter(kind == "final") |>
  select(season, any_of(c(`Home court` = "hca", `Game noise σ` = "sigma_game", `Team spread σ` = "sigma_team",
         `Conference spread σ` = "sigma_conf", `Preseason carry-over` = "b_prev", `Two-season carry-over` = "b_prev2",
         `Weekly drift τ` = "tau", `Bubble rank` = "bench_rank"))) |>
  pivot_longer(-season) |>
  ggplot(aes(season, value)) +
  geom_line(color = c_power, linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(color = c_power, size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~name, scales = "free_y", ncol = 4) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_report
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-hca-path
#| fig-cap: "Home-court edge through each season (per 100 possessions). Early snapshots rest on few games."
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 4
params |>
  group_by(season) |>
  mutate(day = as.numeric(snap_date - min(snap_date))) |>
  ungroup() |>
  ggplot(aes(day, hca, group = season, color = season == max(season))) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = c_power, `FALSE` = "#b9b6ae"), guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "Days since opening night", y = "Home edge") +
  theme_report
```

## Out-of-sample accuracy

Each game is predicted by the latest snapshot before it (opening-week games by the preseason
snapshot), so no result informs its own prediction. The closing line is CBBD's consensus.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-bt
#| tbl-cap: "Backtest by season: margin, win probability and total"
bt$by_season |>
  select(any_of(c("season", "games", "mae", "mae_on_lined", "mae_line", "ats", "brier", "logloss",
                  "mae_total_on_lined", "mae_total_line"))) |>
  gt() |>
  cols_label(season = "Season", games = "Games", mae = "MAE", mae_on_lined = "MAE (lined)", mae_line = "Line MAE",
             ats = "ATS %", brier = "Brier", logloss = "Log loss") |>
  cols_label(any_of(c(mae_total_on_lined = "Total MAE", mae_total_line = "O/U MAE"))) |>
  fmt_number(c(mae, mae_on_lined, mae_line, any_of(c("mae_total_on_lined", "mae_total_line"))), decimals = 2) |>
  fmt_number(c(brier, logloss), decimals = 3) |>
  fmt_percent(ats, decimals = 1)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-vs
#| tbl-cap: "Head to head with Torvik's time-machine ratings and the closing line (games all three predicted)"
bind_rows(bt$vs_period, mutate(bt$vs_overall, period = "All")) |>
  select(Period = period, Games = games, Model = mae, Torvik = mae_torvik, Line = mae_line,
         `Log loss` = logloss, `Torvik log loss` = logloss_torvik, `Closer than Torvik` = closer_than_torvik) |>
  gt() |>
  fmt_number(c(Model, Torvik, Line), decimals = 3) |>
  fmt_number(c(`Log loss`, `Torvik log loss`), decimals = 4) |>
  fmt_percent(`Closer than Torvik`, decimals = 1)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-bt-month
#| fig-cap: "Mean absolute error by month (lined games), model vs. closing line."
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 4.5
bt$games |>
  filter(!is.na(line)) |>
  mutate(month = factor(format(game_date, "%b"), levels = c("Nov", "Dec", "Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr"))) |>
  group_by(month) |>
  summarise(Model = mean(abs(actual - pred_margin)), `Closing line` = mean(abs(actual - line)), n = n()) |>
  pivot_longer(c(Model, `Closing line`)) |>
  ggplot(aes(month, value, color = name, group = name)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) + geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(Model = c_power, `Closing line` = "#52514e"), name = NULL) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "MAE (points)") +
  theme_report + theme(legend.position = "top")
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-calibration
#| fig-cap: "Calibration of pregame home win probabilities (all backtest games)."
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 5
cal <- if (!is.null(bt$calibration)) bt$calibration else
  bt$games |> mutate(bin = pmin(floor(p_home * 20), 19)) |> group_by(bin) |>
    summarise(n = n(), pred = mean(p_home), obs = mean(home_win), .groups = "drop")
ggplot(cal, aes(pred, obs)) +
  geom_abline(linetype = "dashed", color = c_muted) +
  geom_line(color = c_power, linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(aes(size = n), color = c_power) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 6, guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "Predicted home win probability", y = "Observed") +
  coord_equal() + theme_report
```

## Shot model

The make model behind the efficiency signal is fit on the seasons before each season and scored
on that season's shots, so these are out-of-sample. A family off by more than 2 points is
flagged by `check_build.R`; only the three-point model feeds the default signal (`lux100`).

```{r}
#| label: fig-shots
#| fig-cap: "Predicted minus actual make rate by shot family and season (percentage points)."
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 4.5
if (is.null(shots)) {
  cat("No shot_calibration target yet.")
} else {
  ggplot(shots, aes(season, 100 * (pred - actual), color = family)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = c_muted) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = c(-2, 2), color = c_muted, linetype = "dotted") +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.7) + geom_point(size = 1.8) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Predicted − actual (pp)", color = NULL) +
    theme_report + theme(legend.position = "top")
}
```

## Data coverage

```{r}
#| label: tbl-coverage
#| tbl-cap: "Coverage by season"
cov |>
  select(any_of(c(Season = "season", `D1 teams` = "d1_teams", `Not eligible` = "ineligible", `D1 games` = "d1_games",
                  Played = "d1_played", `Non-D1 played` = "nond1_played", `Efficiency signal` = "eff_share",
                  `Closing line` = "line_share", OT = "ot", Neutral = "neutral", `Sites recoded` = "site_recoded",
                  `Torvik prior` = "prior_torvik"))) |>
  gt() |>
  fmt_percent(any_of(c("Efficiency signal", "Closing line")), decimals = 0)
```
